landing.description: Manage students, teachers, attendance, and exams with a clean, modern dashboard built for every device.

landing.portalsDesc: Four dedicated experiences, one connected platform
landing.portalStudentDesc: Track grades, attendance, and timetables from one clean dashboard

landing.portalParentDesc: Follow your children's progress and school announcements in real time
landing.portalAdminDesc: Run the whole school — users, classes, exams, and reports
landing.faqDesc: Everything you need to know before you start
landing.faq1q: How do I get an account?
landing.faq1a: Accounts are created by your school administrator. Contact your school office and they will provision your login.
landing.faq2a: Students, teachers, parents, and school admins each get a dedicated portal with role-based access.
landing.faq3q: Is the system available in Amharic?
landing.faq3a: Yes — switch between English and Amharic anytime from the language menu.
landing.faq4a: Yes. Role-based access, JWT authentication, and encrypted passwords keep school data protected.
landing.faq5q: What devices does it work on?
landing.faq5a: It is fully responsive, so it works on phones, tablets, and desktops.
